The test failed because the expected phase month-span string was not found in the generated XML output.
The assertion `assert '요구사항 분석 및 설계 (2026-08 ~ 2026-10) (3개월)' in ...` failed, showing a mismatch between expected dash separators and the prompt's dot-based date format. The failure suggests the substitution logic failed to produce a contiguous string within a single `<hp:t>` tag. Verification is needed to ensure the regex correctly handles date formatting and that XML layout cache removal didn't interfere with string placement.
